notes: PRがopenであることのみで実行中と判定しない。
CI失敗はPR単位とmain単位を区別する。
マージ済みでもBase44公開・本番E2E・公開版検証が未完なら完了へ加算しない。
2026-10-25 20:28以降にFederation #472〜#475、Simulator #61、Seneschal ACK経路がmainへ進んだが、対象工程の完了条件が揃っていないためcompleted_totalは106を維持。
Actionsの最新失敗はsteps=[]・runner_id=0・runner_name空で、コード実行前のCI基盤停止として扱う。
CI基盤停止中も低リスク変更とPR準備は継続するが、実行コードは自動マージしない。
progress-board/orchestrator-policy.json を自動開発の永続ポリシー正本として追加。
Federation #477 と Simulator #62 がmainへ入り、実計算self-testを使うAPI診断までソース実装済み。
残る最優先ゲートはBase44同期/Publish/公開版E2E証拠とCI runner復旧。
Actionsのsteps=[] / runner_id=0はCI基盤停止であり、named checkのコード失敗として表示しない。
Base44 2-way syncはsource同期であり、利用者向け完了条件はmain Publish + deployed SHA + 認証付きE2E。
GitHub-hosted Actions runner is quota-blocked at account level; jobs fail before any step starts. Public board intentionally omits private billing amounts.
Seneschal #432 removed duplicate Guard runs after main pushes; Simulator #64 added concurrency cancellation, job timeouts and PR-only Chromium E2E to reduce future Actions consumption.

Fed actual-operation source completion: Operation entry/return, 4 mission modes, 15 receipt-gated steps, East Hub/east detour/SIM-02/ETA7 recovery result, authenticated Simulator KPI result, shared priority policy revision, and Seneschal durable ingress are all on main.
Overall completion remains false until Base44 main Publish and authenticated deployed E2E evidence are observed.
Fed実運用ソース完成: 4 Mission、15工程/5アプリACK、予約、共同便、崩壊制御、Keep-Alive、Simulator/Seneschal認証APIをmain固定。Base44 Publish/公開E2Eのみ未確認。

Base44 workspace-key readiness is intentionally not guessed. The release workflow will check BASE44_API_KEY only after a runner is assigned; if missing or invalid, retries stop until the repository secret is configured outside chat.

Seven-app production release is now the canonical gate: Activity → Fleet → Service Hub → Urban → Simulator → Seneschal → Federation. All seven repositories have fail-closed Base44 release workflows; the four consoles, Simulator and Seneschal include deployed cross-app verification and durable/real-compute evidence as applicable.

Federation PR #499 adds the final production E2E workflow. It runs automatically only after a successful Federation release and cannot mark completion until all seven public SHAs and deployed cross-app checks pass.
Actions quota remains the only currently proven execution blocker. Release markers must not be touched until recovery evidence permits the single Activity probe.

orchestrator.current_action: Actions quota中はrelease markerを触らない。復旧証拠後にActivityを単一probeとしてreleaseし、成功したアプリのworkflow head SHAを固定しながら Activity→Fleet→Service→Urban→Simulator→Seneschal→release-state manifest→Federation→final E2E の順で進める。

Fleet release成功後だけService Hub marker更新。exact SHA + app-api health + durable ACK成功を記録。
